job.description: Test N6r: the half-overlap test with its must-fail control set for its measurement. Head A predicts the next token; head B predicts the token 1, 2, 4 or 8 places ahead. 5 new seeds, 20 runs, overlap measured on 256 test-split windows. About 2.3 hours on a T4. Resumable: if a session ends, choose Run all again and finished work is skipped.
